LOCAL RULE 20 SHALL BE FOLLOWED BY THE PARTIES AS WELL AS ALL SAN FRANCISCO LOCAL RULES AND CALIFORNIA RULES OF COURT. THE LAST DAY FOR HEARING SUMMARY JUDGMENT/ADJUDICATION MOTIONS IS DECEMBER 14, 2023. A MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE IS SET FOR THURSDAY, DECEMBER 14, 2023 AT 9:00 AM IN 603. PERSONAL APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED BY ALL UNLESS A PARTY IS GRANTED EXCUSE BASED ON GOOD CAUSE. ORDER SIGNED.
